reason: 该插件面向用户的核心用途是额度监控：在 DeepSeek Harness Web 对话框右下角展示套餐用量，并在展开后提供按渠道分区的用量窗口进度与倒计时视图，主要通过 host 端路由定期拉取外部服务返回的配额数据来更新显示。其配置界面允许为各渠道开关与凭据配置（含 API Key 与可选 Cookie），因此可判断其主要是面板化的外部额度监控工具，而非内容生成、编排或测试类插件。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，在界面中展示多个套餐的用量状态并支持展开查看各窗口额度进度，以帮助用户监控当前可用配额。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that displays usage quota status for multiple plans in the UI and provides an expandable view for per-window quota progress to help users monitor remaining allowance.

capabilities: pulls quota/usage data from external provider endpoints
reads user-supplied credentials and stores configuration state
renders a web overlay badge and expandable usage panel
polls usage state on a fixed interval

reasons.code: README states the plugin shows a right-corner usage badge in the DeepSeek Harness web chat with 5-hour/weekly/monthly windows and per-plan status.
README describes a GET /api/plan-usage route plus GET/POST /api/plan-usage/config for host-side fetch/config flows.
README lists external endpoints and authentication inputs (API keys and optional cookie) used to fetch provider quota information.
package.json declares this package as a DSH web bundle with client injection slots, indicating active UI/runtime integration.
